content:
FINAL CORRECTION — THE 12 SENIOR DEVELOPER CERTIFICATION IS INVALID

The new deep audit proves the previous “12/12 complete” certification was false.

Current verified findings:

- 12 labels exist, but not 12 independent workers.
- Most agents are thin role wrappers over one shared worker/runtime.
- ivx-agent-audit.ts assigns inflated SENIOR scores from static tool lists.
- runFrameworkValidation() can return PASS with agents: 0.
- Multi-agent collaboration is not verified.
- Real 12-agent concurrency is not verified.
- Several agents cannot execute their assigned role.
- GitHub, CI, deployment, replay, rollback, and recovery are not proven per agent.
- Final honest certification: 0/12 VERIFIED.

Do not continue displaying:

“12 senior developers complete”
“100% certification”
“All agents PASS”

until the following work is completed.

==================================================
1. REMOVE FALSE CERTIFICATION LOGIC
==================================================

Fix:

- ivx-agent-audit.ts
- runFrameworkValidation()
- dashboard seniority scores
- any hardcoded PASS
- any static 90–93% scoring
- any validation that passes with zero agents

Required rules:

- agents.length must equal expected registry count
- every required agent must have a unique ID
- every required role must exist
- every required test must have execution evidence
- zero agents must return FAIL
- missing evidence must return FAIL
- shared worker must be labeled SHARED WORKER, not independent agent
- no score may be based only on declared tools

Add regression tests:

- zero agents → FAIL
- missing agent → FAIL
- duplicate IDs → FAIL
- shared worker mislabeled independent → FAIL
- missing heartbeat → FAIL
- no completed job → FAIL
- no evidence → FAIL
- all requirements satisfied → PASS

==================================================
2. CREATE A REAL AGENT REGISTRY
==================================================

Create a production registry for the 12 agents.

Each record must include:

- agent_id
- agent_name
- role
- runtime_id
- worker_id
- model
- capabilities
- status
- heartbeat
- current_job
- last_completed_job
- last_failed_job
- queue_depth
- concurrency_limit
- owner_enabled
- created_at
- updated_at

No static UI-only cards.

The dashboard must read directly from this registry.

==================================================
3. CLASSIFY THE CURRENT ARCHITECTURE HONESTLY
==================================================

For each of the 12 current entries classify:

- REAL INDEPENDENT AGENT
- SHARED WORKER WITH ROLE
- UI-ONLY LABEL
- PLACEHOLDER
- MOCK
- BROKEN
- UNKNOWN

Return exact files and runtime mapping.

Do not call shared role wrappers independent agents.

==================================================
4. FIX THE SHARED WORKER CRASH
==================================================

The audit reports a zod/v4 module crash preventing the senior-developer worker from starting.

Identify:

- exact package
- exact import
- exact file
- exact stack trace
- exact runtime version
- exact dependency conflict

Fix it.

Required:

- worker starts
- heartbeat appears
- one safe job completes
- restart recovery passes
- no hidden fallback to mock mode

==================================================
5. FIX THE PLAN.MD PATH BUG
==================================================

The self-execution test has a hardcoded PLAN.md path.

Replace hardcoded sandbox paths with:

- repository-root resolution
- configurable workspace path
- safe path validation
- cross-platform path handling

Add tests for:

- local runner
- GitHub Actions runner
- Render worker
- clean-room checkout
- missing PLAN.md
- alternate repository root

==================================================
6. CREATE REAL AGENT EXECUTION ISOLATION
==================================================

Each agent must have:

- unique identity
- isolated job ownership
- separate task state
- separate logs
- separate heartbeat
- separate failure state
- independent cancellation
- independent retry counters
- resource limits
- concurrency limits

Physical processes are not mandatory for every agent, but logical execution isolation must be real and durable.

If agents share a worker pool, report:

SHARED WORKER POOL

and prove independent job isolation.

==================================================
7. ASSIGN REAL CAPABILITIES PER AGENT
==================================================

For each of the 12 agents define:

- required capabilities
- optional capabilities
- prohibited capabilities
- credentials required
- approval requirements
- allowed repositories
- allowed deployment environments
- maximum duration
- retry limit
- cost limit

Do not give every agent broad production access.

==================================================
8. TEST EVERY AGENT WITH A REAL JOB
==================================================

For each agent execute one role-specific production-safe test.

Required evidence:

- agent ID
- job ID
- worker/runtime ID
- task
- files inspected
- files changed if approved
- commands
- test results
- final status
- timestamps
- proof ledger ID

No shared evidence reused across all 12.

==================================================
9. VERIFY CODE READ AND WRITE
==================================================

For every development agent verify:

- repository read
- search
- root-cause analysis
- safe temporary file creation
- approved file edit
- diff generation
- rollback of temporary test
- evidence capture

Do not allow destructive production changes during certification.

==================================================
10. VERIFY TEST EXECUTION
==================================================

Per applicable agent verify:

- lint
- typecheck
- unit test
- integration test
- security scan
- dependency scan
- mobile validation
- browser validation
- database validation

A skipped command is not PASS.

==================================================
11. VERIFY GITHUB AND CI
==================================================

For applicable agents verify:

- GitHub authentication
- repository target
- branch access
- commit
- push
- CI trigger
- CI result read
- failure handling

Return real:

- commit SHA
- GitHub Actions run ID
- job results

==================================================
12. VERIFY DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

For deployment-capable agents verify:

- owner approval
- exact SHA binding
- single-use authorization
- CI green
- Render deployment
- /health
- /version
- proof ledger
- replay rejection
- rollback

Return real deployment IDs.

==================================================
13. VERIFY FAILURE RECOVERY
==================================================

For every agent test an applicable failure:

- timeout
- invalid credential
- test failure
- network error
- worker restart
- cancellation
- stale job
- duplicate job

Verify:

- exact error reported
- no false PASS
- safe terminal state
- retry behavior
- recovery
- proof record

==================================================
14. VERIFY MULTI-AGENT COLLABORATION
==================================================

Run one real task using multiple agents.

Example:

Landing member registration does not sync to Members.

Required handoff:

- Architect maps flow
- Web agent reproduces
- Backend agent inspects API
- Database agent checks RLS/insert
- QA agent writes test
- Security agent validates abuse controls
- DevOps agent deploys
- Release agent verifies rollback

Required evidence:

- task owner
- handoff records
- no duplicate edits
- no conflicting branches
- final merged result
- shared proof ledger

==================================================
15. VERIFY CONCURRENCY
==================================================

Run:

- 2 simultaneous jobs
- 4 simultaneous jobs
- 8 simultaneous jobs
- 12 simultaneous jobs

Measure:

- jobs started
- jobs completed
- failures
- conflicts
- queue delays
- memory
- CPU
- timeouts
- duplicate work
- corrupted state

Do not claim concurrency based only on inFlight flags.

==================================================
16. FIX THE DASHBOARD
==================================================

The owner dashboard must stop showing static “senior” cards.

For each agent show:

- classification
- live status
- runtime/worker
- current task
- progress
- heartbeat
- last evidence
- failures
- queue
- capability status
- owner controls
- verified senior status

Use only live data.

==================================================
17. DEFINE REAL SENIOR-DEVELOPER CERTIFICATION
==================================================

An agent may be marked VERIFIED SENIOR DEVELOPER only if it passes:

- role-specific diagnosis
- repository inspection
- root-cause confirmation
- approved code change where applicable
- test execution
- evidence quality
- failure recovery
- owner controls
- no fabricated claims
- production verification where applicable

Static tool declarations do not count.

==================================================
18. RE-RUN THE 12-AGENT CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Return one table:

Agent:
Role:
Classification:
Unique ID:
Unique execution state:
Heartbeat:
Real job completed:
Code read:
Code write:
Tests:
GitHub:
CI:
Deploy:
Recovery:
Owner-controlled:
Evidence:
Truthfulness:
Final verdict:
Blockers:

Allowed verdicts:

- VERIFIED SENIOR DEVELOPER
- VERIFIED ROLE AGENT
- SHARED WORKER WITH ROLE
- PARTIAL
- FAIL
- PLACEHOLDER

==================================================
FINAL SYSTEM VERDICT
==================================================

Return:

REAL AGENTS PRESENT:
X / 12

INDEPENDENT AGENTS:
X / 12

VERIFIED SENIOR DEVELOPERS:
X / 12

VERIFIED ROLE AGENTS:
X / 12

SHARED WORKER ROLES:
X / 12

PLACEHOLDERS:
X / 12

BROKEN AGENTS:
X / 12

MULTI-AGENT COLLABORATION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

12-JOB CONCURRENCY:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

AUTONOMOUS CODE CHANGE:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

AUTONOMOUS QA:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

FINAL CERTIFICATION:
X/12 VERIFIED

Do not reuse the old certification.

Do not mark 12/12 until every agent has separate current execution evidence.
